title: Racing the arena course
target: How to get through an arena race in R.E.P.O., given that the game builds the course from track pieces with a start and an end, shows a timer and a pulsing arrow, and gives the winner a crown.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A crew ready to start a race
An agreement on who drives and who rides

steps.do: Find the start piece before anything else.
steps.because: the course is laid out from a start piece and an end piece with pieces between them (ArenaRaceTrackPieceStart, ArenaRaceTrackPieceEnd)

steps.do: Follow the arrow rather than guessing the turns.
steps.because: the interface carries an arrow of its own that pulses (ArenaRaceArrowPulsate)

steps.do: Watch the timer instead of the score.
steps.because: the race has a timer of its own on the interface (ArenaRaceTimerUI)

steps.do: Look for the pad on the straight sections.
steps.because: a boost on the course comes from a pad of its own (Arena Race Boost Pad)

steps.do: Wait for the crown rather than assuming the result.
steps.because: the game gives the winner a crown, and the player's own crown is a separate piece (Arena Crown, Arena Crown Player)

commonMistakes: Turning before the arrow changes and losing the course.
Ignoring the timer until the race is over.
Treating the crown as decoration rather than as the result.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
